name: Columbia (Tennessee, United States)
description: Divided horizontally blue over red, with a white star in the upper hoist and a wave of interwoven blue and red stripes across the middle for the Duck River.
history: Columbia is a city in and the county seat of Maury County, Tennessee. The flag was adopted on 11 May 2023 (designed by local resident Bryson Leach, winner of an online public vote among three finalists from 41 contest entries, and adopted on 11 May 2023, according to Flags of the World citing the city; the blue over red recalls Columbia's presidential history and the Tennessee flag).

features.role: wave of interwoven blue and red stripes for the Duck River
